# Space Ninja
[color=#999999][italic]"Spider of the night, silent is my bite."[/italic][/color]
You are an elite mercenary sent by the [color=#66FF00]Spider Clan[/color] to sow chaos aboard the station. You are equipped to operate silently—but lethally.
Whether you leave a trail of blood or keep things relatively peaceful, your discipline has taught you that [italic]you must at least attempt to complete your objectives.[/italic] For honor!
## Standard Equipment You begin with an implanted [color=cyan]death acidifier[/color], ensuring that your valuable equipment will remain out of enemy hands if you are captured or killed.
Your bag contains [bold]tools[/bold] and a [bold]survival box[/bold]. You also carry a [color=cyan]jetpack[/color] and a [color=cyan]pinpointer[/color] that will guide you to the station.
## Your Suit
The most important item you possess is [color=cyan]your suit[/color]. Without it, none of your abilities will work. The suit draws power from its [bold]internal battery[/bold]. You can replace it, and a [italic]high-capacity battery[/italic] will turn you into a [italic]truly formidable ninja[/italic].
[bold]You can recharge the internal battery directly[/bold] with [color=cyan]your gloves[/color]. Check its current charge by examining the suit or looking at the convenient battery indicator on your screen.
Your outfit also includes [color=cyan]special boots[/color] that keep you agile, upright, and anchored without consuming power. Your [color=cyan]visor[/color] also protects you from flashes.
## Ninja Gloves
[color=#66FF00]These gloves are your bread and butter.[/color] They are made from [bold]insulated nanomachines[/bold], allowing you to infiltrate restricted areas quietly without leaving fingerprints.
You have an action that toggles the gloves. When enabled, they grant access to [bold]special abilities[/bold] that activate when you interact with an empty hand while combat mode is disabled.
Your abilities include: - Emagging doors and airlocks. - Draining power from [bold]transformers[/bold] such as APCs, substations, or SMES units (the higher the voltage, the more efficient the drain). - Delivering an electrical shock to a mobile target, stunning it and dealing minor damage. - Tampering with [bold]station equipment[/bold] to complete [color=#66FF00]objectives[/color].
## Energy Katana
[bold]You have sworn to live by the sword and refuse to use firearms.[/bold] Fortunately, you have a very impressive blade.
Your [color=cyan]energy katana[/color] deals heavy damage and can be [bold]recalled to your hand[/bold] at the cost of suit power. The farther away it is, the more energy it takes to retrieve.
While holding it, you can also [color=cyan]teleport[/color] anywhere you can see, [bold]including through windows[/bold]. The charges needed to dash regenerate slowly, so keep one or two in reserve for a quick escape.
## Spider Clan Charge
This is a [color=cyan]modified C-4 explosive[/color] carried in your pocket. It creates a powerful explosion, but [bold]must be armed directly at the target location[/bold]—doing so is one of your objectives.
It cannot be activated manually, so attach it to a wall or piece of furniture near the assigned target. Choose carefully: it cannot be removed once attached.
## Objectives
- Download \[9-13\] research nodes: use your gloves on an R&D server with several unlocked technologies. You may need to unlock technologies yourself if there are not enough to steal. - Emag \[15-40\] station doors: use your gloves to hack the required number of airlocks. - Detonate the Spider Clan charge: place the charge at the designated location and set it off. - Trigger a [textlink=\"threat\" link=\"MinorAntagonists\"]: use your gloves on a communications console. - Set everyone to wanted: use your gloves on a criminal records console. - Survive: do not die.
